_note: The single place the brand is configured. Nothing about YMnotes identity
may be written into a page template, a stylesheet or a script: change a URL
here and the header link, the QR artwork, the social page and the closing
page must all follow from this file, then be re-verified.
`destinations` is the authority for every link and every QR. The strings
were decoded from the supplied brand artwork and are reproduced EXACTLY as
encoded - they must never be tidied, re-cased or 'corrected'.
`brand_home_url` is where the header mark points. YMnotes has no separate
homepage today, so it falls back to the primary destination; when a site
exists, set it here and nothing else changes.

publication._note: PUBLIC BOOK IS NOT A BUILD REPORT. A reader-facing page may never disclose how the book was made - no tools, paths, hashes, scripts, gates or measurements. That belongs in the manifest, the QA reports and the ledger, where it can actually be checked.
